boundaryNotes: 20 separate bootstrap processes are retained separately from 80 clean, 80 no-op, 80 incremental and 80 startup processes.
Five candidate/candidate no-change pairs and five alternating original/candidate pairs; each matrix arm samples one distinct subprocess for each phase.
Reduced 10/1000 manual/macro debug matrix, native engine, one module, four jobs, fixed pins; no legacy full-matrix budget identity.
No-op includes package planning and cache validation. It is not a pure planning timer and must not be subtracted from independent phases.
Fresh inert clean consumer startup includes process loading/catalog construction/count output/teardown; OS caches are not flushed.
Native CPU is time user+system for command and waited descendants at native precision. Active cores is observed CPU/wall, not a CPU allocation reservation.
Native RSS is the largest measured process peak, not simultaneous compiler-family RSS.
Unique process manifests preserve stdout/stderr hashes and cleanup; flat compatibility logs and workspace binaries are overwritten.
Startup executable before/after hashes identify executed clean binaries without retaining a copy. Final incremental binary hashes are separate.
Generated Swift source hash matches all arms; generated manifest hashes include absolute checkout paths and legitimately differ.
80 common envelopes project only 160 clean/incremental wall/RSS observations. CPU, bootstrap, no-op, startup and new input hashes remain native.
Bootstrap workspaces differ in cache age. No cold-setup optimization or dependency-download improvement is claimed.

retainedDecisions: No public API or product/import graph change.
No typed router, macro expansion, module boundary or compiler parallelism change.
Existing benchmark workloads retain their identities; new independent populations have explicit boundaries.
runtimeBoundaryNotes: Each target population has exact duration sums and complete bounded histograms with ten-microsecond cells. Histograms do not retain individual durations.
All runtime requested operations succeed with no adverse outcomes and zero cleanup ownership; comparison groups are reaped.
Medians of five process means and paired relative changes are descriptive, not confidence intervals or numerical gate approval.
Loop CPU includes validation/collection. Process peak RSS through cleanup includes setup/warmup and precedes report construction. Live allocator gauges do not count allocation events.
Direct prepared-payload writer is a serialization CPU control without DefinitionPlan admission equivalence.
String length is token repetitions, not constant bytes across ASCII/escaped/Unicode. Stress payloads above the default one MiB use explicit custom limits.
Concurrent invocation sums overlap; gross throughput is measured loop completion, not derivable by subtracting independent intervals.
Followup populations remain separate and do not replace first observations.
selectedChange: Exact bounded DefinitionPlan JSON byte accounting without serializing a complete document or sorting keys; original shape/preflight ordering and Foundation escaping preserved.
